L6·N5357unmasked layer
Fires on the pivot word inside "select one from a set" constructions — e.g. "Which **do** you use", "the solution **that**'s right for you", "one of **these** examples", "one or more **of** the following", "choose your operating **system**", "which course to **take**" — i.e. framing a choice among presented options rather than any single lexical item.
